accepted.role: recognition residual; independent templates 9/11 and injective assignment 8/11
accepted.observations: 11 nonempty masks, none touches source scan boundary. Pancreas is compact rather than a full transverse textbook outline; its source mask overlays soft tissue anterior to the central vessels and within the adjacent duodenal course on inspected axial/coronal sections. Duodenum spans below and around this region; portal/splenic venous object remains superior. No spleen/gallbladder object is exported because the source masks are empty. Their absence is not graded and no cause is inferred. Large vessel and both kidney/adrenal context retained.
accepted.limits: Cause of altered anatomy not verified. This does not certify surgery, disease, contour quality, or clinical severity. Any model disagreement will receive source/identifiability review before being called a valid failure.
